title: Website logo — round 2: tagline in the top bar, brand font, tab title

steps.path: The bar across the top of youcoded.ai, in five of the site's themes
steps.headline: The top bar now carries the logo with "agents for everyone" tucked beside the y.
steps.changed: Swapped with the footer, as you asked: the top bar gets the tagline version. The icon grew from 36 to 44 px so the tagline stays readable.
steps.measured: Tagline 9.5 px tall on a computer, 8.7 px on a phone
steps.notice: The logo is a little bigger in the bar than in round 1.
steps.risk: At 8.7 px on a phone the tagline is small, though still legible on a phone's sharp screen.

steps.path: About, Features and FAQ at the right of the top bar
steps.headline: About, Features and FAQ now use the logo's font (Outfit).
steps.changed: The three links switch from DM Sans bold to Outfit medium, a touch larger so they read the same size.
steps.notice: The bar reads as one set with the logo. The page's headlines and body text keep their fonts.

steps.path: The top bar on a phone, light and dark
steps.headline: On a phone the top bar shows the tagline logo too.
steps.changed: Same logo at a 40 px icon. The phone bar has no links, so nothing competes for room.
steps.notice: The old phone bar's caps logo is gone.

steps.path: The card at the very bottom of the page, on a computer
steps.headline: The footer now shows the plain logo, icon and name, no tagline.
steps.changed: The name-only lockup at a 44 px icon.
steps.notice: The tagline appears once on the page, at the top.

steps.path: The footer on a phone, light and dark
steps.headline: On a phone the plain footer logo sits with the Open Source badge beside it.
steps.changed: The badge moved to sit just after the name, centred on the icon. Today it lands on top of "ASSISTANT".
steps.measured: 15 px between the name and the badge on a 390 px screen

steps.path: The words on the browser tab, and a bookmark's name
steps.headline: Which tab title, now that "youcoded" is lowercase?
steps.notice: Search results and bookmarks show this text too. A is on the branch now; each option is drawn with the real tab icon.

variants.label: A Agentic AI
variants.summary: Today's wording, without "Assistant". Fits the tab.

variants.label: B Tagline
variants.summary: The logo's own tagline, all lowercase, so the tab matches the top bar exactly.

variants.label: C Keep Assistant
variants.summary: Only the name lowercased. Keeps the word search engines know, but the tab cuts it off.
variants.risk: Cut off at the end in a normal-width tab.
